boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities in Santa Paula, including free city programs, library events, and public cultural gatherings.

cards.entity_name: Santa Paula Community Center Pickleball Free Play
cards.title: Pickleball Free Play
cards.subtitle: Community Center Auditorium, 530 W Main St
cards.notes: Bring a friend and join the drop-in pickleball sessions; the city lists all skill levels as welcome and says registration is not required.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, no-registration indoor game session for ages 12 and up.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Paula Parks & Recreation lists Community Center pickleball free play as free, with no registration required.
cards.source_title: Santa Paula Parks & Recreation Summer 2026 Guide
cards.access_notes: Mondays, 9–11 a.m. and 6–8 p.m.; confirm the current recreation guide before going.

cards.title: Concerts in the Park
cards.subtitle: Santa Paula Creek Sports Park, 301 Harvest Loop
cards.notes: Pack a blanket or use the grass seating and meet friends for the city’s live-music evening; food trucks are optional rather than required.
cards.short_summary: Free-entry outdoor concert dates at the city’s creek sports park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calendar states that Concerts in the Park at Santa Paula Creek Sports Park has free entry.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula: Concerts in the Park
cards.access_notes: The listed 2026 series dates are June 19, July 17, and August 21, 6–9 p.m.; check for future dates.

cards.entity_name: Summer Movie Night Series at Santa Paula Creek Sports Park
cards.title: Outdoor Movie Night
cards.subtitle: Santa Paula Creek Sports Park
cards.notes: Meet up for the city’s outdoor movie series and bring your own blanket or chair; the recreation guide labels movie nights as free admission.
cards.short_summary: A free city movie-night stop at the Santa Paula Creek Sports Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Summer 2026 Recreation Guide advertises its Movie Night Series with free admission, including a Sports Park date.
cards.source_title: Santa Paula Parks & Recreation Summer 2026 Guide
cards.access_notes: The guide lists a Sports Park movie on August 14, 2026; verify future movie dates with Parks & Recreation.

cards.title: Library Movie Night
cards.subtitle: Blanchard Community Library, 119 N 8th St
cards.notes: Use the library’s free movie listing as a cue to watch its calendar with friends; this screening included free popcorn while supplies lasted.
cards.short_summary: A documented free library movie program with a social, low-key format.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calendar calls the Blanchard Community Library screening a free movie and states that free popcorn was provided while supplies lasted.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula: Free Movie! Jurassic World Rebirth
cards.access_notes: This listing was for June 25, 2026; consult the library calendar for upcoming free screenings.

cards.title: Tiny Art Show Painting
cards.subtitle: Blanchard Community Library, 119 N 8th St
cards.notes: Drop in with a friend to make a mini canvas at the library’s supplied-materials session; the event notice says participants need not bring anything.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on library art session with materials and mini canvases supplied.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calendar says the Tiny Art Show Painting Session provides all supplies and mini canvases and requires participants to bring nothing.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula Calendar: Tiny Art Show Painting Session
cards.access_notes: The listed sessions were June 11 and June 20, 2026; check the library calendar for a current equivalent.

cards.title: Borrow a State Parks Pass
cards.subtitle: Blanchard Community Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a day trip, then ask the library to check out a California State Parks Pass; return it like a library item after the outing.
cards.short_summary: A library checkout that can cover day-use parking at participating California state parks.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Paula’s official newsletter says Blanchard Community Library offers a free California State Parks Pass checkout for free day-use parking at more than 200 parks.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula Official Newsletter
cards.access_notes: Availability is limited by the library’s pass collection; ask Blanchard Community Library before planning the trip.

cards.entity_name: Santa Paula Youth Center Drop-In Program
cards.title: Youth Center Drop-In
cards.subtitle: Santa Paula Youth Center, 413 N 13th St
cards.notes: Eligible Santa Paula youth can use the supervised drop-in space to play games, work on homework, or spend time in the lounge with peers.
cards.short_summary: A free after-school setting with game, wellness, homework, and lounge spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s recreation guide describes the Santa Paula Youth Center as a free, drop-in after-school program for youth who reside in Santa Paula.
cards.access_notes: For Santa Paula-resident youth; the guide lists Monday–Friday, 3–6 p.m. Confirm eligibility and current hours first.

cards.entity_name: Aviation Museum of Santa Paula Chain of Hangars
cards.title: Chain of Hangars Tour
cards.subtitle: Aviation Museum of Santa Paula, 800 E Santa Maria St #E
cards.notes: Go on a First Sunday and use the museum’s free map to explore the participating hangars in any order, on foot or by tram.
cards.short_summary: A free monthly aviation-history outing through Santa Paula Airport hangars.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calendar states that the Aviation Museum’s First Sunday Chain of Hangars exploration is free.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula: SP Airport Museum
cards.access_notes: First Sundays, 10 a.m.–2 p.m., according to the listing; verify the next opening date with the museum.

cards.title: Spring into Summer
cards.subtitle: Santa Paula Creek Sports Park, 301 Harvest Loop
cards.notes: Attend with friends to talk with local organizations and use the day’s free services; the city describes it as a community event for families.
cards.short_summary: A free city community-services gathering at the creek sports park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City calendar lists Spring into Summer at Santa Paula Creek Sports Park with a cost of FREE.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula: Spring into Summer
cards.access_notes: The documented event occurred June 20, 2026; watch the City calendar for future community-service events.

cards.title: Teague Park Community Celebration
cards.subtitle: Teague Park, 300 S Steckel Dr
cards.notes: Bring a group to the city’s family-oriented gathering for games, music, booths, and egg hunts; its published event notice identifies it as free.
cards.short_summary: A documented free city community event held at Teague Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s event page describes the Teague Park Easter Celebration as a free family event with egg hunts, music, games, prizes, and booths.
cards.source_title: City of Santa Paula: Easter Celebration
cards.access_notes: The documented event date was March 28, 2026; check the City calendar for the next Teague Park community event.

warnings: Several city event listings document past 2026 programs; verify future dates and availability before making plans.
